company.name: Deliverect
company.shortDescription: Deliverect integrates online orders from food delivery channels into restaurants’ POS to improve their operational flow.
company.description: Deliverect is a subscription-based service that integrates third-party online ordering platforms like Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Glovo, and Doordash into restaurants’ point-of-sale systems, automating the inbound online order flow through a single point and eliminating the requirement for restaurant staff to monitor multiple devices and manually re-enter orders into their existing system.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-powered, API-first platform that centralizes digital ordering, menu management, delivery operations, and sales data across restaurant and retail channels.
productsAndServices.name: Deliverect Platform

productsAndServices.description: A centralized restaurant operations hub for aggregating orders, managing menus, and accessing sales, performance, and third-party delivery data from one platform.
productsAndServices.name: Deliverect Restaurants

productsAndServices.description: A direct-to-consumer ordering solution for creating branded websites, mobile apps, and QR-code ordering experiences with integrated promotions, payments, and loyalty.
productsAndServices.name: Deliverect Direct

productsAndServices.description: A delivery orchestration service that assigns orders across third-party and in-house fleets using delivery partner integrations, business rules, cost, coverage, and estimated arrival time.
productsAndServices.name: Dispatch by Deliverect

productsAndServices.description: A revenue protection and marketplace monitoring solution that tracks storefront availability, performance, pricing, promotions, customer sentiment, and refund activity across delivery platforms.
productsAndServices.name: Sentinel by Deliverect

productsAndServices.description: A modular API suite for building custom first-party ordering experiences and connecting branded applications to POS, loyalty, kitchen, payment, and delivery systems.
productsAndServices.name: Deliverect Commerce API

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series D round raised $150,000,000, or 63.34% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,633,133 to $1,400,000,000, a 302.17x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
